title: Tuna and Vitello Stir-Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring fresh tuna and vitello, stir-fried to perfection. This recipe is quick, easy, and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced vitello and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Remove the vitello from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of cooking oil to the skillet, then add the minced garlic and grated ginger.
Cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the tuna fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Return the vitello to the skillet and stir in the Italian zesty dressing, chopped cilantro, and tonnato sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tuna and vitello stir-fry hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
